entities.summary: Gerald Bernard Wilkins is an American former professional basketball player. He is a 6-foot-6-inch (1.98 m) shooting guard/small forward, who played collegiately at Moberly Area Community College and the University of Tennessee at Chattanooga before a career in the NBA.
